name: Cron Travel Mode
description: Review OpenClaw cron jobs, move approved explicit-timezone cron schedules to travel-local time, and safely restore them.

maxInventoryJobs.description: Maximum number of compact cron jobs returned during draft inventory before asking the user to filter.

maxInventoryBytes.description: Maximum serialized compact inventory size returned during draft inventory before asking the user to filter.

defaultLateRestoreThresholdHours.description: Hours after trip end before an overdue restore requires fresh user confirmation.

activationGraceMinutes.description: Minutes after trip start when a passive activation may still proceed without late-activation confirmation.
